description: This file contains system initialization code for the NXP KE1XF microcontroller, including clock configuration, watchdog setup, and platform-specific initialization, with references to Zephyr RTOS and NXP SDK components.

methods.name: clk_init
methods.description: Initializes system clocks and PLL configurations for the KE1XF device.

methods.name: ke1xf_init
methods.description: Performs system clock and PLL initialization, disables code cache if configured, and sets up memory protection.

methods.name: z_arm_watchdog_init
methods.description: Configures the watchdog timer with specified timeout and control settings.

methods.name: z_arm_platform_init
methods.description: Calls SystemInit from the NXP SDK to perform platform-specific initialization.
